title: A Delightful Afternoon Wine Tour: 4 Wineries & Charcuterie
includes: A gourmet cheese sample plate at one of the winery stops
Stops at 4 of Niagara’s finest wineries (12-16 total wine tastings)
An expert guide who's fun, friendly, and knowledgeable
Pick up and drop off at a single location within Niagara Falls or Niagara-on-the-Lake
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Visit 4 boutique Niagara wineries in one afternoon, with guided tastings and a charcuterie pairing along the way. Afternoons in wine country have a rhythm all their own — lively, social, and perfectly paced so you can enjoy every stop without feeling rushed.

With 12–16 wines spread across the afternoon, the experience builds naturally — from your first glass to that point where the energy lifts, conversations flow, and everything just clicks.

Throughout it all, our world-class tour guides keep things seamless and engaging — creating an atmosphere that feels fun, welcoming, and far from a typical "tour."

By the time it wraps up, you've had a full wine country experience — and still have your evening ahead of you.
